name: WellIntegrityBarrierManager
tagline: Integrity category, annulus pressure vs MAASP, barrier tests, anomalies and dispensations for every well – in one Power Apps control.
description: A plug-and-play well integrity desk for oil & gas operators: integrity category per well with the reasons behind it, annulus pressure matrix with trends against user-entered MAASP and bleed-down records, barrier element test schedule with pass/fail and next due dates, anomaly board from discovery to close-out, dispensations with expiry and actions. Demo data on drop; connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, model-driven views and Power Pages. Documentation aid – limits come from your engineering calculation.
features: Annulus gauges and SVG trends vs MAASP
Barrier test schedule with overdue / due soon and bulk pass
Dispensations with expiry countdown and extensions
Actions with owners and due dates
Bulk moves, CSV export, delete with undo
